items.description: Local Weather is a web application that automatically show users their local weather forecast. This application uses ipinfo.io API and OpenWeatherMap API.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.
Comprehensive mashup for real-time UK traffic information.
Shows US neighborhood boundaries and neighborhood names, pulling from Maponics Neighborhood Boundaries GIS mapping data.
Displays geographic location of a Domain or IP address on Google Maps.
A site that aims to make it easier to decide what movies you can watch with your friends.
German-Korean Dictionary is a translation site that uses the Forvo API to help with pronunciation.
Marinexplore.org is the easiest way to explore, discover, and share public ocean data. The mashup uses the Google Maps API to display various ocean statistics.
iBlueSky is a mind mapping application for the iPhone, and this mashup allows users to save mind maps from iBlueSky directly to their Box.net accounts.

Mohiomap takes important documents and files in the Cloud and enables users to understand how they relate to one another and to visualize them in a way the brain understands. Starting with Evernote and Dropbox, Mohiomap provides a change of perspective on existing information - displaying it in a way which adds meaning and understanding.
Downloads Shopify store data directly into Microsoft Excel.
This tool calculates the total value of items in your Etsy shop, and presents a few other statistics too.

Progressive Contacts is a fundraising company that specializes in making phone calls (live, automated phone surveys, and automated phone calls) to reach supporters for different political campaigns. Some of the services that Progressive Contacts provide include text messaging, field consulting, financial consulting, data analysis, script drafting, and more.
Allow user to see European football matches on map and apply filter based on distance between user and stadium or date of match
Service for you to collect, organize, and share information for shopping, travel or any other research.
Measures the distance between two locations.
With mappeo, you can geo search YouTube videos and filter specific keywords.
Bookmark all your favourite videos,sightseeing,pictures on a world map.

FotoFuze is a professional 3D product photography and 2D image enhancement service. Make professional product photography out of ordinary photographs from ordinary cameras, for free, then add them to your Etsy listings.
Bookr is a tool to create photobooks using Flickr images. Photobooks may be e-mailed or embedded in blogs.
Track US flights in realtime. See results overlaid on a Google Map. If bored, click the Track Random Flight button.
Branded Red Letter Days affiliate site for SEO and PPC. Uses Red Letter Days feed and Google Maps API to map gift experiences by UK locations.

Google map and bars, lounges, restaurants and clubs etc. Links to reviews. Venues have map with nearby venues. Site also has a Mapchat mashup mixing maps and chat and a Twitter mashup in the members section, showing your status and pic in your profile.
Attractions in Dublin Ireland mapped on a Google Map.
A showcase of the best travel attractions around the world with videos, maps, descriptions, recent blog posts and pictures for almost every attraction.

Perfecto is a web application that allows users to sell and buy used bikes, with knowledge of the sellers and buyers. Perfecto partners with Strava which gives users information about the history of the bikes for sale and build a rapport between seller and buyer. This application uses the Bike Index API.
Mobile web applications let you share location info as signature to the messages in email and SMS.
A rich, interactive map with the current conditions from thousands of locations worldwide.
Site developed to share walking and running routes.
Iron Skull is a google map mashup of world class premier custom chopper builders.

Vote USA is an online project that allows voters to compare political candidate bios, pictures, and, most importantly, their positions and views on issues. With the goal to inform voters with information and issues relevant to their political platforms, Vote USA aims to provide people with up-to-date and reliable information about the political candidates.
TaskAmigo helps you get things done, so you can focus on the good things in life. Post your task, and runners will place their bid to do your task!
Dubwithme lets you and your friends re-dub a Youtube video on the internet.

The Domain Rank Checker is designed to uncover the keywords that drive most organic traffic to your website. Or you can use this tool to perform competitor research and discover what keywords your competitor is targeting and ranking for.
Google Mapping ACT Scores by state in math, reading, science, and English categories.
dsmn is simplest and fastest application to listen and explore music. Free and unlimited music.
Determine the cost to charge your EV. Precise and down to the penny based on your energy plan, your EV model and level of charge.
PhoneTap lets you record your outgoing phone calls, giving you a record of who you talked to and what was said. Plays both parties a notice that the call is recorded at the start of each call.
Sentiment analysis is performed by extracting words of positive or negative meanings from Twitter status, and animated smiley then is drawn accordingly

30-06-2011 JavaScript Updated. Raddio.tk is an HTML5 experimental player that uses the Jamendo.com API to load songs based on selected user tags. Works with Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Safari using Windows XP/Vista/7 and Linux (Ubuntu).
The True Knowledge Firefox add-on enhances your search engine results by inserting a direct answer to your question above your regular search results.
Sightseeing via a World Video Map. Watch and map videos on Google Maps and Google Earth.
